name: d-services
description: D-services: one platform for delivery services (courier, removals, freight, earthworks, food, rides)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @d-services/charging && npm run build -w @d-services/api && npm run build -w @d-services/courier-web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @d-services/charging && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @d-services/charging && npm run dev -w @d-services/api
